summary: Variables can be passed at runtime with --extra-vars/-e (as a single-quoted string in several formats) or requested with vars_prompt.
questions: How do I pass variables on the command line?

answer_card.title: Defining variables at runtime
answer_card.answer_md: Use `--extra-vars` / `-e` with a single-quoted string (key=value, JSON, or `@file`), or prompt users with `vars_prompt`.
